title: Coupled Heterogeneity to Dimeric Site-Specific Binding by the POU-Family Transcription Factor OCT2.
authors: Terrell, J Ross; Poon, Gregory M K
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体学、滴定分析和分子动力学模拟研究POU家族转录因子OCT2二聚体与DNA位点特异性结合的异质性与动态机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作且采用物理模拟方法，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: POU-family transcription factors regulate metazoan gene expression via a bipartite DNA-binding domain consisting of two covalently linked helix-turn-helix subdomains, POU(S) and POU(H). POU factors bind as dimers to DNA half-sites to form complexes with a variable quaternary structure. To enhance the knowledge of the physical chemistry of dimeric POU/DNA recognition, we carried out a crystallographic and titration analysis of the cooperative homodimer formed by the POU factor OCT2 and an optimized palindromic DNA site known as MORE. The data evidence strong heterogeneity in the binding and formation of secondary complexes in site-specific DNA recognition by OCT2 at thermodynamic equilibrium. These secondary complexes are strictly contingent to the site-specific complex, detectable at subsaturating OCT2 concentrations, and cooperate with nonspecific binding to guide the affinity of the site-specific complex. Modulation with salt and poly[d(I-C)] unmasks the compensation between nonspecific DNA depleting unbound OCT2 on the one hand while driving specific binding by intermolecular transfer of OCT2 via secondary complexes on the other. Molecular dynamics simulations extend a mechanism, previously proposed for POU monomers, in which the two subdomains dynamically cross-link DNA strands to form supramolecular dimeric POU/DNA complexes at equilibrium.
abstract_zh: POU家族转录因子通过由两个共价连接的螺旋-转角-螺旋亚结构域POU(S)和POU(H)组成的双部分DNA结合域调控后生动物基因表达。POU因子以二聚体形式结合DNA半位点，形成具有可变四级结构的复合物。为增强对二聚体POU/DNA识别的物理化学认识，我们进行了由POU因子OCT2与优化回文DNA位点（称为MORE）形成的协同同源二聚体的晶体学和滴定分析。数据表明，在热力学平衡下，OCT2对位点特异性DNA识别中，次级复合物的结合和形成存在强烈异质性。这些次级复合物严格依赖于位点特异性复合物，在亚饱和OCT2浓度下可检测到，并与非特异性结合协同作用，以引导位点特异性复合物的亲和力。通过盐和poly[d(I-C)]的调节，揭示了非特异性DNA消耗未结合OCT2与通过次级复合物进行OCT2分子间转移驱动特异性结合之间的补偿机制。分子动力学模拟扩展了先前针对POU单体提出的机制，其中两个亚结构域动态交联DNA链，在平衡状态下形成超分子二聚体POU/DNA复合物。
